title: Validation data, coefficients and script for an integrated humus and NPK balance decision-support framework
description:
Validation data, model coefficients and a reproducible script accompanying the manuscript A GIS-enabled environmental decision-support framework for integrated humus and NPK balance modelling in crop-rotation planning (submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software).

Contents: humus balance and humus stock values transcribed from Kudria et al. (2024, doi:10.31073/agrovisnyk202401-08) used for the cross-regional validation of the humus module; representative coefficients of the deployed calculator; a worked N-P-K balance example; a term-by-term comparison of NPK balance coefficients with an independent long-term rotation-balance study; and a Python script that reproduces the validation metrics and figure. Values transcribed from third-party publications remain attributable to their original authors; see README.md.
